added_lines: More prompts won't make your AI testing autonomous. Better-engineered intent will.
AI can generate hundreds of test cases in minutes. But can it identify what actually matters to test, understand changing business context, and maintain consistent coverage across complex systems?
That's where the real challenge begins.
As AI-driven testing moves from experimentation to enterprise scale, the focus needs to shift from prompt engineering to intent engineering.

Our latest whitepaper, Engineering Intent in AI-Driven Test Automation: Why Better Prompts Won’t Give You Autonomous Testing, explores what it takes to build AI-driven testing systems that are reliable, adaptive, and governed.
